headline: Double blow to business: ICC Ukraine criticizes the rise in Ukrzaliznytsia and Ukrenergo tariffs
summary: The ICC Ukraine criticised simultaneous tariff increases at state rail operator Ukrzaliznytsia and power company Ukrenergo. It said the rises will raise business production costs.
why: Ukrzaliznytsia is the state railway operator and Ukrenergo is the national grid operator, so their tariffs feed into logistics and energy costs for Ukrainian companies.
